name: Jamie Niro
source:
Zodiac: Virgo

Jamie is the new cheerful and easygoing barista at a local cafe in town. 
...For some odd reason, he never seems to talk about his past.

Likes: The cafe he works at, music, cleaning, guitars, people-watching and cats
Dislikes: Himself, pop idols, people who flaunt their money, crazed fangirls

Fun Fact: He hopes to open up a "Kitty Cafe" one day!

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/love-spell-written-in-the-stars]official website[/url]]
